title.zh: 尽管持续进行谈判，油价仍因伊朗海峡紧张局势飙升 3%
title.en: Oil prices surge 3% on Iran Strait tensions despite ongoing talks

summary.en: Markets showed mixed sentiment ahead of Friday's close as investors balanced geopolitical tensions in the Middle East against solid U.S. productivity and labor cost data, with oil prices surging on Iran Strait concerns while Treasury yields rose modestly.
summary.zh: 市场在周五收盘前表现分化，投资者在中东地缘政治紧张与扎实的美国生产力和劳动力成本数据之间权衡。油价因伊朗海峡问题飙升，同时美债收益率小幅上升。

title.zh: 亚洲市场因中国经济数据表现不一；欧洲股市反弹
title.en: Asian Markets Mixed on China Economic Data; European Stocks Rally

summary.en: Asian markets closed mixed amid ongoing China economic data releases. European stocks showed early gains on positive manufacturing PMI readings, while oil prices remained under geopolitical pressure from Middle East tensions.
summary.zh: 亚洲市场在中国经济数据发布中表现不一。欧洲股市因制造业 PMI 读数向好而早盘上涨，但油价仍受中东地缘政治紧张局势压制。

title.zh: 霍尔木兹缓和预期推高股指期货，并压低原油冲击
title.en: Hormuz De-escalation Hopes Lift Futures and Ease the Oil Shock

summary.en: Premarket tone is modestly risk-on: index futures are higher on Hormuz de-escalation hopes, softer labor data, and a revived AI trade. The caution is that the 10Y yield is still near 4.66% and gold is also bid, so the open looks supported but still headline-sensitive and rate-sensitive.
summary.zh: 盘前基调偏风险偏好：市场在霍尔木兹局势缓和预期、偏弱就业数据和 AI 交易回暖的推动下高开。需要警惕的是，10Y 美债收益率仍接近 4.66%，黄金也同步走强，因此这更像是一个有支撑但仍对头条和利率高度敏感的开盘。

title.zh: 伊朗局势缓和预期压低油价，原油跌幅超 7%
title.en: Oil Sinks More Than 7% as Iran De-escalation Hopes Reprice the Tape

summary.en: Premarket tone is decisively risk-on: index futures are sharply higher after WTI collapsed more than 7%, easing the inflation and rate scare that has been hanging over equities. The main caution is that the 10Y yield is still grinding up to 4.66%, so the rally favors high-quality growth and other duration-sensitive winners only if rates stay contained.
summary.zh: 盘前情绪明显偏风险偏好：在 WTI 重挫逾 7% 后，三大指数期货齐涨，通胀和利率冲击得到缓解。需要留意的是，10Y 美债收益率仍上行至 4.66%，因此本轮反弹更偏向高质量成长和久期资产，前提是利率别继续失控。

title.zh: 美指期货上涨押注中东停火；医疗保健合并谈判引发关注
title.en: Wall Street Futures Rise on Middle East Truce Hopes; Healthcare Merger Talks Spark Interest

summary.en: US stocks poised to open higher as three major index futures rise on Monday. Oil prices fell below $84 amid hopes for de-escalation in the Middle East following US-Iran diplomatic signals, while healthcare sector gained focus after Bristol Myers Squibb and AstraZeneca merger talks sparked a potential ~$400B deal that could reshape the global pharmaceutical landscape.
summary.zh: 美股周一开盘料上涨，三大指数期货齐扬。受美伊外交缓和信号推动，油价跌破 84 美元；医疗保健板块因百时美施贵宝与阿斯利康合并谈判而受到关注，双方可能达成价值约 4000 亿美元的交易，或重塑全球制药格局。

title.zh: 半导体板块分化显现：AI 供应链选择性资本轮动加剧
title.en: Semiconductor Sector Diverges: AI Supply Chain Selectivity Emerges

summary.en: Friday markets close with mixed sentiment as semiconductor stocks diverge on AI supply chain dynamics. Semiconductor names show wide dispersion - NVIDIA and AMD rally while Micron and Intel retreat, signaling selective capital rotation within the chip sector.
summary.zh: 周五市场收盘呈现混合情绪，半导体股因人工智能供应链动态而出现分化。芯片板块内资本轮动明显——英伟达和超微崛起而美光和英特尔退守，显示选择性资金配置特征增强。

title.zh: 微软 earnings后大涨超 9%，AI 乐观情绪抵消美联储利率担忧
title.en: Microsoft Jumps Over 9% Post-Earnings as AI Optimism Offsets Fed Rate Worries

summary.en: Premarket focus centers on post-Microsoft earnings sentiment and pending PCE inflation data. Tech sector faces mixed signals with AI optimism versus rate sensitivity, while major index futures rise ahead of key macro releases.
summary.zh: 盘前焦点集中在微软财报后的情绪和即将公布的 PCE 通胀数据。科技板块呈现分歧信号，AI 乐观与利率敏感性交织，主要指数期货在关键宏观发布前上涨。

title.zh: 半导体股票因芯片需求担忧暴跌，市场对 AI 放缓产生疑虑
title.en: Semiconductor stocks tumble on chip demand fears amid AI slowdown concerns

summary.en: Semiconductor weakness led broad tech decline with NVDA, AMD down ~8% on chip demand concerns. Financials and healthcare stocks provided support while futures point to cautious open. Key watch: whether AI sector selloff is healthy profit-taking or fundamental shift.
summary.zh: 对芯片需求的担忧引发半导体股下跌，拖累科技板块，英伟达与 AMD 各跌约 8%。金融和医疗保健股票提供支持，而期货预示谨慎开盘。关键看点：AI 板块抛售是健康获利了结还是基本面转变

title.zh: 芯片抛售加剧，NVIDIA 领跌半导体板块前夕美联储决定
title.en: Chip Selloff Deepens as Nvidia Leads Semiconductor Sector Decline Ahead of Fed Decision

summary.en: Markets mixed as chip selloff and easing geopolitical tensions create divergence. S&P futures -0.25%, Nasdaq slips -1% ahead of open while oil prices continue declining (WTI/Brent down ~4%) amid relaxed Middle East pressures. Fed decision looms tomorrow alongside big tech earnings scrutiny with AI spending facing renewed attention.
summary.zh: 市场分化：芯片抛售和地缘政治缓和形成背离。标普期货 -0.25%、纳指盘前跌 1%，而油价在中东压力缓解下持续走低（WTI 与布伦特原油均下跌约 4%）。美联储决定即将公布，同时大科技财报受审查，AI 支出面临新一轮关注。

title.zh: 特朗普暂停对伊朗空袭，美股期货上涨
title.en: Trump Pauses US Strikes on Iran, Wall Street Futures Rally

summary.en: U.S. stock futures rose as a pause in U.S.-Iran hostilities eased geopolitical concerns. Technology led gains while oil fell. The Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia was in talks to provide about $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI’s Ohio data-center project.
summary.zh: 美伊交火暂停缓解地缘风险，美股期货上涨，科技股领涨，油价下跌。《华尔街日报》报道，英伟达正商谈为 OpenAI 的俄亥俄州数据中心项目提供约 2,500 亿美元融资担保。

title.zh: 油价跌破$100，地缘政治风险小幅缓和
title.en: Oil Prices Drop Below $100 as Geopolitical Risk Eases Slightly

summary.en: US futures trade mixed as investors digest geopolitical tensions, elevated oil prices below $100, and AI hyperscaler earnings pressure. Intel's strong bounce contrasts with broader tech weakness following Mag7 rout on Thursday.
summary.zh: 美股期指分化，投资者消化地缘紧张、油价虽回落但仍居高位 ($98 附近)，以及大厂 AI 营收预期压力。英伟达等巨头周四大跌后科技股承压，Intel 强劲反弹形成鲜明对比。

title.zh: 期货下跌：AI 资本支出担忧与伊朗紧张局势拖累市场
title.en: Futures Fall on AI Capex Concerns and Iran Tensions

summary.en: Stock futures slip as AI capex concerns and Iran tensions weigh on sentiment, with oil closing near $95/Bbl adding pressure to energy-intensive tech sectors. Pre-market focus centers on whether growth stocks can hold despite earnings overhang around Alphabet and Tesla reports.
summary.zh: 美股期货承压，AI 资本支出担忧与伊朗紧张局势拖累市场情绪，油价回落至$95/桶附近对能源密集型科技板块形成压力。盘前关注重点在于成长股能否承受 Alphabet 和特斯拉财报季的盈利不确定性。

title.zh: 美国对伊朗空袭升级推动油价飙升至 95 美元/桶；通胀担忧拖累期指走弱
title.en: Oil Surges Above $94 as US Strikes on Iran Escalate; Futures Slip Amid Inflation Concerns

summary.en: US stock futures trade lower as surging oil prices above $94/barrel and Middle East tensions weigh on sentiment. Investors await key earnings from Tesla, Alphabet, IBM, and ServiceNow while balancing geopolitical risks with AI spending outlooks.
summary.zh: 美股期指走弱，布伦特原油攀升至 94 美元/桶以上且中东局势加剧打压市场情绪。投资者在等待特斯拉、Alphabet、IBM 和 ServiceNow 等关键财报的同时，平衡地缘政治风险与 AI 支出展望。

title.zh: 芯片股引领市场反弹：NVIDIA、AMD 和英伟达等半导体公司涨幅扩大，受益于明朗的财报前景
title.en: Chip Stocks Lead Market Rebound: Nvidia, AMD, and Intel Rally as Semiconductor Earnings Outlook Brightens

summary.en: US chip stocks rebound ahead of big AI earnings as semiconductor sector expected to contribute 44% of S&P profit growth; oil trades above $83.70 driven by Iran tensions with Strait of Hormuz closure concerns keeping energy prices elevated.
summary.zh: 美股芯片股在大型人工智能财报前反弹，半导体行业预计占标普指数利润增长的 44%;受伊朗紧张局势及霍尔木兹海峡关闭担忧影响，油价维持在$83.70 以上的高位。

title.zh: 台积电业绩强劲但芯片股持续下跌
title.en: Chip Stocks Extend Declines Despite TSMC's Strong Earnings

summary.en: U.S. equity futures remain mixed as chip sector weakness drags down tech-heavy indices despite UnitedHealth's earnings beat lifting Dow components. Oil prices climb amid U.S.-Iran tensions, raising inflation concerns and pressuring energy-exposed stocks like airlines while boosting precious metals.
summary.zh: 美股期货震荡不定，芯片板块疲软拖累科技股指数，尽管联合健康股价大涨提振道指成分股。受美伊紧张局势影响油价攀升引发通胀担忧，压制航空等能源敏感股票同时推升贵金属价格。

title.zh: 美国重启对伊朗霍尔木兹海峡封锁，油价飙升
title.en: Oil Surges as US Reinstates Blockade on Iran Strait of Hormuz

summary.en: U.S. stocks are mixed in premarket trading as investors weigh soft inflation data against escalating Middle East tensions, with oil surging and Treasury yields hitting eight-week highs. Bank earnings boosts sentiment but geopolitical risk premium is weighing on broader equities.
summary.zh: 美股盘前交易呈现分歧，投资者在软通胀数据与中东紧张局势升级之间权衡：油价飙升、美债收益率创八周新高。银行股业绩提振情绪，但地缘政治风险溢价抑制大盘表现。

title.zh: 伊朗冲突重启：新一轮美军打击引发油价飙升，压制成长股
title.en: Iran Conflict Resumes: Fresh U.S. Strikes Drive Oil Surge, Weigh on Growth

summary.en: U.S. markets open on risk-off sentiment as Gulf conflict escalates: Trump confirms resumption of strikes against Iran, pushing Brent to $85 and WTI near $80. Tech stocks lead declines amid inflation reacceleration fears from oil supply risks.
summary.zh: 美股早盘避险情绪升温：海湾冲突升级，特朗普确认恢复对伊朗打击，布伦特原油飙升至 85 美元、WTI 逼近 80 美元。科技股领跌市场，油价重燃通胀再加速担忧。

title.zh: 特朗普宣布霍尔木兹海峡航运费并重启伊朗港口封锁，美油期货涨至 79.91 美元/桶（+2.3%），市场对供应中断担加剧
title.en: Trump announces Hormuz shipping fees and Iran port blockade, lifting WTI oil to $79.91 (+2.3%) amid supply disruption fears

summary.en: Geopolitical escalation in the Middle East dominates premarket action as Trump's Hormuz toll and Iran blockade lift oil prices above $85/bbl, pushing U.S. Treasury yields to two-month highs while broadening tech sector weakness from memory chip demand concerns.
summary.zh: 中东地缘政治升级主导盘前交易，特朗普霍尔木兹海峡收费和伊朗港口封锁推动油价突破 85 美元/桶美油；通胀预期升温抬升美国国债收益率至两个月高位；大科技股受存储芯片需求担忧拖累普遍走弱。
